fresh_ax.label:
Zeus is the face of your AI assistant. Connect it below, then click Zeus to talk.

The line under the messages tells you what Zeus is waiting on.

Your assistant can change Zeus when you ask (on by default; switch in Settings › General).

settings_ax.label: Zeus runs it. Choose an agent and folder. Zeus starts and looks after your assistant.
Connect your own. Connect an agent you already run and manage yourself.
Assistant: Ready to Start. Choose a folder to start.
Codex. Not installed: Codex (the codex command). Install it, then press Check Again.
OpenCode. Not installed: OpenCode (the opencode command). Install it, then press Check Again.
It works here, and reads this folder's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
Ask first, Default. Asks before editing files or running commands.
Plan only. Looks around and proposes a plan; asks before acting on it.
Never ask. Does only what you've already allowed; refuses the rest without asking.
Accept edits. Edits files without asking; asks before other commands.
Auto. A safety check approves routine actions; asks about the rest. Some models fall back to Ask first.
Bypass permissions, Unrestricted, warning. Never asks. It can run any command and change any file you can. Confirm once in Terminal the first time.
Claude Code's own modes. When it asks, Zeus shows a card that opens Terminal.
Logins and folder-trust prompts always wait for you in Terminal.
Used when your assistant starts a new conversation.
Local time. Equal start and end means all day. Questions and agent activity take precedence.

stop_ax.label: Zeus runs it. Choose an agent and folder. Zeus starts and looks after your assistant.
Connect your own. Connect an agent you already run and manage yourself.
Assistant: Running. Claude Code is ready in ~/Zeus Assistant.
Watch or type to it in Terminal:
Codex. Not installed: Codex (the codex command). Install it, then press Check Again.
OpenCode. Not installed: OpenCode (the opencode command). Install it, then press Check Again.
It works here, and reads this folder's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md.
Ask first, Default. Asks before editing files or running commands.
Plan only. Looks around and proposes a plan; asks before acting on it.
Never ask. Does only what you've already allowed; refuses the rest without asking.
Accept edits. Edits files without asking; asks before other commands.
Auto. A safety check approves routine actions; asks about the rest. Some models fall back to Ask first.
Bypass permissions, Unrestricted, warning. Never asks. It can run any command and change any file you can. Confirm once in Terminal the first time.
Claude Code's own modes. When it asks, Zeus shows a card that opens Terminal.
Logins and folder-trust prompts always wait for you in Terminal.
Changes apply when Claude Code is ready. It restarts and keeps the same conversation.
Local time. Equal start and end means all day. Questions and agent activity take precedence.
